base_planner_config_historical.target_contact_radius_rule: half TRAIN prototype extent plus one voxel
base_planner_config_historical.unknown_policy: blocked except recorded local current/target contact allowances
base_planner_config_historical.collision_scope: discrete visible-free-space proxy, not a continuous 2cm physical-clearance certificate; depth projection and surface/grid quantization errors are not jointly bounded
base_planner_config_historical.diagonal_policy: all touched neighbor voxels, including edge/corner ties, must be free
base_planner_config_historical.attachment_scope: original neighboring free cells within unchanged start/target contact radii; target component unchanged
base_planner_config_historical.connector_collision_scope: complete segment distance to finite nonselected visible points >= original 20mm plus fixed-step observed-ray/contact checks; not continuous solid/visibility certification
